{{Quote|Now, I rented a place for Laseema by the Kragget restaurant, so I'm going to move in there for the time being and see how we cope between us.''"<br />"''You rented an apartment for her?''"<br />"''You think I'd leave her stuck at Qibbu's? I'm a regular at the Kragget and there are plenty of CSF lads using the place, so it's ''secure.|Kal Skirata and Besany Wennen|<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
'''Laseema's apartment''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], at the edge of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city world's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]]. Housed within the same [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] complex as the [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]] all-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], the apartment occupied an entire floor above the diner and could be accessed from its rear. The apartment was purchased for [[Laseema]]—a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] formerly employed at [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]]—by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. During an [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|anti-terror operation]] based at the Hut, Laseema had entered into a relationship with one of Skirata's surrogate sons, a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] by the name of [[Atin Skirata|Atin]]; considering the young woman as good as family due to that relationship, Skirata bought the home for Laseema in order to help her get a fresh start away from her exploitative employer. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] went on, the apartment came to serve as a safehouse and meeting place for the various members of [[Clan Skirata]], before finally being abandoned in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] as Laseema and the Skirata clan departed Coruscant for [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==Description==
The apartment was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TC" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], nestled within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Housed within the same [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] building complex as the [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]] all-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], situated at the edge of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]' [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]], the apartment occupied an entire floor above the dining establishment, and gave off a sense of being an urban [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. It was accessible from the rear of the Kragget, beyond the kitchens, using a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] or a flight of stairs,<ref name="O66" /> and required a code key to enter.<ref name="TC" /> The apartment's doors opened into a large living room—likely converted from a previous warehouse area—around which several other rooms were arranged, and had access to an emergency exit that led up the roof of the complex in which it was located. The apartment was furnished with a [[Couch/Legends|couch]], several chairs, a table, a [[conservator]] that was kept stocked with [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and cabinets for storage. A [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]] also hung on one of the walls of the apartment's living room.<ref name="O66" />

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|military contractor]], [[Kal Skirata]], undertook an anti-[[Terrorist/Legends|terror]] [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|operation]] alongside a team of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. During the course of the covert operation, the counter-terror team was based out of the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]], where a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] by the name of [[Laseema]] was employed at the [[Time/Legends|time]]; while the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were headquartered there, a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldier]] known as [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] entered into a relationship with Laseema. After their mission came to a successful conclusion,<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> Skirata decided to help Laseema find a new life away from the exploitative, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-owned cantina. He purchased an apartment for Laseema above the Kragget restaurant—a secure diner he and numerous [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] frequented—intending to allow the young Twi'lek to stay there free of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|charge]].<ref name="TC" /> Though Laseema accepted Skirata's initial generosity and moved into the apartment, leaving her old job, she insisted on gaining employment at the Kragget as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] in order to remain self-sufficient.<ref name="O66" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], following the [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of his grandson [[Venku Skirata|Venku]], Skirata moved into one of the spare rooms of Laseema's apartment in order to house and care for the [[Youngling/Legends|child]], as his [[Parent/Legends|parents]]—[[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commando [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]—were on active duty with the Republic Grand Army. Not long after, another room was offered to Laseema and Skirata's good friend [[Bardan Jusik]], a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in need of a place to stay following his recent departure from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Laseema's apartment was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] via a mention in the third entry into the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels, [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 30]], [[2007]]. The apartment later appeared in full in Traviss' sequel to ''True Colors'', [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], published just over a year later on [[September 16]], [[2008]].
